scope: 6 videos, 3 seeds per WB variant;首/中/末帧 reviewed

variants.note: Most complete head/ear/rear-hair context; no gross floating head or neck break observed.
Neutral neck anchor reconnects F face successfully; no obvious proportion failure, but it provides less hair/ear context.

comparison.role_separation: WB_neck_only is cleaner because it carries no head/hair identity content.
comparison.visual_continuity: WB_face_erased is richer because it retains rear-head, ear, and hair-to-shoulder context.
comparison.production_candidate: Keep both as role-specific candidates; prefer neck_only when minimizing head competition is the priority, prefer face_erased when rear-head/hair continuity is important.
comparison.limitations: Single action prompt, 3 seeds, manual ordinal review; no close-up-only or static neutral-pose control yet.
